newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHISPANK BOARD TO GET NEW MEMBERS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHISPANK BOARD TO GET NEW MEMBERS.

text.p: Uhispank's shareholders will vote for four new board members at their meeting on Saturday, the bank said on Friday.
Eight of the present board members, which represent the investment companies which formed the bank, will resign.
Member of parliament Andres Lipstok, Pakterminal chairman Aadu Luukas, Tallinn mayor Robert Lepikson and Rakvere meat factory chairman Tiit Kouhkna will be put up as canditates for the board.
"The board needs to be modernized, as a lot of changes have happened since the present board was formed in 1995," the vice president of Uhispank, Margus Schults, told Reuters.
